description: FairOdds keeper bot — takes the forecast engine's daily slate, commits predictions to ForecastRegistry (hash on-chain before trading opens), creates each market on the pm-AMM with custom seed = model probability, and after expiry attests resolutions (Pyth-derived) and drives pm-AMM resolution/claim.
name: fairodds-keeper
notes: STEP 3 (Nov 21): ForecastRegistry DEPLOYED to devnet (program G4Gib3N2vGVR4JaGjCGyvwHidz1EF3hjdztQYHZ17VgU, deploy tx EysiVYthJRkLA6WvHEmSxqun6k7m1bF13BPY5pzcKPuGUc11uy2RxEgbSExQhdVTprsdvM8oGW4RYfmzW4Ex7vc). `npm run plan` remains the dry-run (its registry client has no live transport, so sends stay gated). `npm run live` (src/liveRun.ts) is the one-market live runner: choose marketId -> derive market PDA -> commit_prediction -> initializeMarket+depositLiquidity with that id -> wait -> Coinbase-at-expiry resolution (documented fallback for the stale Pyth devnet feed) -> resolveMarket -> attest_resolution -> on-chain record verification. State checkpointed to examples/step3-live-state.json after every step.
